title: Craftable coins
description: A really lightweight and simple datapack that adds gold coins!
body:
This datapack adds a recipe for golden coins 8 gold ingots and a diamond in the centre!
##

You can buy things from player with these coins and _you_ can decide how much value do coins have!

##

Install it by putting the file into world/datapacks folder!

Disable it by using command slash datapack disable [datapack]
